component.name: Kulan Fleet
component.summary: Look after your organisation's Kulan OS computers

description.p: See every computer that joins your organisation, and keep them all secure, compliant and up to date.

ul.li: Which computers need security updates, and which don't meet the organisation's policy
Policies for automatic updates, the firewall, the screen lock and disk encryption
Each computer's apps, alerts and an activity log
Lock, restart or erase a lost or stolen computer. Erasing needs the user's permission and an encrypted disk

description.p: Sign in with your work email. Computers join from Kulan Settings.

screenshot.caption: Every computer in the organisation, and what needs attention
